Agent Name: Blu-Ray_Expert
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: After the data structure was revealed (with the true headers at row 3 and a mostly empty 'Platform' column), the agent incorrectly dropped all rows with NaN in 'Platform' and then filtered on 'Platform' == 'Blu-Ray'. The spreadsheet appears to use section headers in the 'Title' column (e.g., "Blu-Ray") to denote platform groups rather than per-row 'Platform' values. By not recognizing this and failing to forward-fill or parse these section headers, the agent guaranteed an empty result and concluded "No Blu-Ray entries found," leading to the wrong solution instead of identifying "Time-Parking 2: Parallel Universe" as the oldest Blu-Ray.
